title: Modernize Virtual World MCP server (fix 55 FastMCP test failures, add Timeline/Seeder/Grid/Trigger/Memory tools, trim action bloat)

sections.what: Audit and modernize mcp_server.py: fix the 55 broken FastMCP FunctionTool tests in tests/test_mcp*.py, add MCP tools for modern Viwo subsystems (Timelines, Past Observation Seeder, Player Map, World Grid/Scopes/Structures, Triggers, Scene Snapshot, associative memory retrieval, and full add_player_memory fields), and consolidate redundant /api/action one-liner wrappers.
sections.why: mcp_server.py currently covers only 54 of 260+ Flask routes (~21%), has 55 failing tests due to FastMCP's FunctionTool wrapper change, exposes stale parameters on add_player_memory, and lacks access to Timelines, Observation Seeding, World Grid/Scopes/Structures, Triggers, and Commons while spending ~18 of its 85 tools on redundant /api/action wrappers.
sections.how:
1. Update tests/test_mcp*.py to unwrap FastMCP FunctionTool objects (e.g. helper _call(tool, *args, **kwargs) calling tool.fn if present) so all 69 existing MCP tests run and pass cleanly.
2. Expand add_player_memory in mcp_server.py to forward location, tags, entity_ids, world_datetime, emotions, category, and source to POST /api/players/<name>/memories/entry.
3. Add high-leverage MCP tools for:
   - Timelines: timeline_state, timeline_fork, timeline_switch, timeline_redo, timeline_expand_past, timeline_connect, timeline_fork_soak
   - Observations & Map: seed_observations (/api/world/seed-observations), get_player_map (/api/players/<name>/map)
   - Associative Memory & Scene: retrieve_memories (/api/players/<name>/memories/retrieve), get_player_knowledge, get_scene_snapshot (/api/scene/<name>)
   - World Building: world_grid, world_scopes, structures, triggers, and Commons state/post
4. Consolidate redundant 1-line /api/action wrappers behind run_action(command) (keeping only the most essential shortcuts like look/go/speak) so tool context stays compact.
5. Add unit/contract tests covering the new MCP tools against the Flask test client.

acceptance.text: All existing MCP test suites (tests/test_mcp*.py) pass against current FastMCP (fixing the 55 FunctionTool callability failures).

mcp_server.py exposes high-leverage modern engine tools: Timeline operations (state/fork/switch/redo/expand-past/connect/fork-soak), batch Past Observation Seeder (/api/world/seed-observations) & player map (/api/players/<name>/map), World Grid / Scopes / Structures, Triggers, Scene Snapshot, and associative memory retrieval.
add_player_memory accepts full modern parameters (location, tags, entity_ids, world_datetime, emotions, category, source).
Redundant one-line /api/action wrappers are consolidated or trimmed so total MCP tool count stays lean and agent-friendly, with pytest coverage for new tools.

custom.browser_ui: N/A - backend MCP server (mcp_server.py) and pytest suites only; live edits made via MCP automatically appear in the browser UI via existing X-WV-Editor / /api/events SSE.
